messages:
maria: Starting rollout for model-catalog v2.4 to crossplane. Small canary (1% traffic) in us-west for 10m, then 10% in eu-central, then fanout. tagging @noah @tanvi

deploybot: Scheduled rollout: start=2923456800, canary=1%, canary_window=10m, smoke-tests=nightly-smoke-ml. :rocket:

noah: I’ll watch latency / p95 tracing. If p95 > 300ms or error_rate delta > 1.5% sustained 3m -> signal rollback.

tanvi: Also watch embedding quality evals — eval-run id=eval-2923. If mean cosine shift > 0.03 or rouge degrade > 1.0 point, we stop.

sre-oncall: Adding thresholds to ops playbook. Rolling drain steps: drain nodes with tag=rollup-v2.4 for canary before fanout.

maria: Ops runbook note: to drain a pool run:
```bash
./infra/drain_pool --tag rollup-v2.4 --region eu-central --grace 120
```
No new instances after drain until smoke pass.

deploybot: Canary started (ts=2923456850). Observing traffic routing to variant=tile-quant-v2.

lucas: Quick check: observability dashboard -> https://dash.redwood/model_rollups/2923456789

sre-oncall: seeing p95 spike in us-west at +40ms at t+4m, not a deal. error rate flat. continuing.

tanvi: eval-run 2923 results incoming… embedding cosine mean shift = -0.02 (within threshold).

maria: ok moving to regional fanout: shifting eu-central to 10% at 2923457000. pin older variant (v2.3) in ap-south as fallback hold.

noah: note: if eu p95 > 350ms OR error_rate > +2% sustained 3m -> auto-pin to v2.3 and alert @oncall-sre
deploybot: Fanout step executed. eu-central=10%. rollback-policy=auto-pin, notify=oncall-sre,email.

tanvi: sending release notes: https://go.redwood/releases/rollup-v2.4 (model card + evals attached)

maria: final decision: full roll scheduled in 1h if no regressions. Everyone acknowledge.

oncall-sre: ack. I’ll be in the channel for the next 90m.

noah: ack

lucas: ack

maria: if we need manual rollback run:
```bash
./deploy rollback --catalog model-catalog --from v2.4 --to v2.3 --regions "eu-central,us-west"
```

maria: Closing ops thread; will post final status after 1h. :white_check_mark:
